title: SDET Analyst
description:
Job Description

Summary of This Role
Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing.

What Part Will You Play?
- Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Participates within a collaborative software development approach to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts basic impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs basic testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed.
- Writes and executes moderately complex application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i.e., white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests moderate improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies basic improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates basic to mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing.
- Develops standard software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes standard code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.
- Installs and uses basic to moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys basic to moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs basic to moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops basic to moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI.
- Uses performance, load, security, and service virtualization testing tools to conduct basic testing, analysis and results interpretation. Builds, scripts, and generates data used in testing. Analyzes moderately complex system performance and responses during loads. Applies a basic knowledge of procedures, methodology and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related compliance to testing activities using automation. Applies knowledge of service virtualization concepts and its applicability for application testing.
- Works with stakeholders, business, developers and other analysts to develop test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing, and learns to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Begins to build a base knowledge of using multiple environments to validate test conditions and reviews data values while learning the various components of the systems and the applications. Reports, tracks defects and defect resolutions, closure and participates in root cause analysis.
- Acts as a single point of contact for assigned small, less complex client projects with regard to test activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients.
- 
What Are We Looking For in This Role?
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered
- Typically Minimum 2 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with software testing, coding, designing, and developing

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree

- Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?
- SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE - Developing professional expertise, applies company policies and procedures to resolve a variety of issues.

- JOB COMPLEXITY - Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of a variety of factors. Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action. Builds productive internal/external working relationships.

- SUPERVISION - Normally receives general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects or assignments.

- Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc.

- Programming Languages - Java, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc.

- Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, Service Virtualization, etc.

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages.
- Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
- Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
- Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
- Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
- Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
- Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.

Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation.
- Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
- Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
- Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
- Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation.
- Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
- Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
- Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
- Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
- Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
- Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.
- Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr.

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

- UI (Web/Mobile)
- API and integration layers
- Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
- Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
- Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
- Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
- Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
- Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
- Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle

- Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
- Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
- Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
- Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
- Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
- Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing

Observability & Debuggability

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
EazyML, Recognized by Gartner, EazyML (www.EazyML.com) specializes in Responsible AI. Our solutions facilitate proactive compliance and sustainable automation and The company is associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia.ai.

We're looking for an experienced QA engineer who can protect the quality of both our conventional software and our LLM-powered features, where pass/fail scripts alone are not enough.

You will own testing end to end: reviewing requirements, running manual and automated tests, tracking defects to closure, and building evaluation suites that catch hallucinations, regressions and safety issues before customers do. You will set measurable release criteria for RAG pipelines, multi-step agents and the APIs and apps around them.
The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a solid grounding in testing methodologies, and enjoys working with engineering, product and customer teams to keep improving how we test.

Key responsibilities
Core QA and test planning
- Review product specifications, designs and requirements to flag risks and testability gaps before testing starts.
- Write test plans, test cases and test scripts with engineers and product managers.
- Run manual and automated functional, regression and exploratory tests across environments for new and existing products.
- Identify, document and track defects to closure in JIRA, with clear reproduction steps.
- Reproduce customer-reported and production issues in test environments and help troubleshoot them.

GenAI and LLM evaluation
- Design test strategies and test plans for LLM features, RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
- Build and maintain golden datasets, evaluation rubrics and adversarial test sets for each use case.
- Measure output quality with automated metrics (faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision/recall, groundedness) and LLM-as-judge evaluations, calibrated against human review.
- Detect and track hallucinations, factual errors, bias, toxicity and policy violations.

Agent and RAG testing
- Test multi-step agents end to end: tool and function calling, planning, memory, error recovery and human-in-the-loop handoffs.
- Validate retrieval quality, chunking and embedding changes, and the effect of prompt or model changes on downstream answers.
- Run red-teaming for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage and PII exposure.

Automation and CI/CD
- Build automated evaluation and regression suites in Python and integrate them into CI/CD so every prompt, model or code change is scored before release.
- Automate API, integration, web UI and mobile app tests for the applications that wrap our GenAI services.
- Maintain and improve test scripts, tools and frameworks to make each testing cycle faster.
- Run performance and load tests covering scalability, latency, throughput, token usage and cost per request.

Quality ownership
- Define release gates and quality KPIs, take part in release planning, and confirm every component meets the bar before release.
- Report quality metrics and test results to engineering, product and management.
- Check that products meet security standards and industry regulations, including data privacy and PII handling.
- Monitor production quality through tracing and observability tools, and turn user-reported failures into new test cases.
- Review release notes and product documentation for accuracy and completeness.
- Give developers feedback on design changes that improve testability.
- Support UAT and help customers validate the product during POCs and enterprise deployments.
- Improve QA processes, tools and best practices, and keep up with new testing and LLM evaluation tools.

Required qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 3–7 years in software QA or SDET roles, covering both manual and automated testing, including at least 1 year testing LLM, ML or GenAI applications.
- Strong Python for test automation, with pytest or a similar framework; working knowledge of Java or JavaScript is a plus.
- Hands-on experience with at least one LLM evaluation framework, such as Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo, TruLens or LangSmith evaluations.
- Working knowledge of LLM application stacks: prompting, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or CrewAI.
- Solid grasp of testing methodologies, with UI and API automation experience: Selenium or Playwright, JUnit or TestNG, and Postman, REST Assured or Python requests.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or Jenkins), Git, JIRA or similar bug tracking, and Agile ways of working (Scrum or Kanban).
- Understanding of non-deterministic system testing: statistical pass rates, sampling, and when to use human review.
- Clear written communication for test reports, defect write-ups and quality dashboards, plus strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently or in a team.

Nice to have
- Experience with cloud AI platforms and cloud-based test environments: Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or Databricks Mosaic AI.
- LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, Arize Phoenix or MLflow tracing.
- Security testing practices and AI safety tools such as Garak or PyRIT, and familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
- Performance and load testing with JMeter, LoadRunner, Locust or k6.
- Mobile app testing on iOS and Android.
- SQL and database knowledge for data verification.
- Testing ML models for accuracy, drift, fairness or explainability.
- ISTQB, CSTE or similar QA certification.
- Experience in fast-paced startups or with enterprise customer deployments, handling several priorities at once.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
About Us
We're rebuilding vertical software with AI — from the inside.

Embrace owns the software running inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. We acquire entrenched vertical software businesses and rebuild them around AI — products, operations, go-to-market, all of it. Our Venture Lab launches new AI-native products into those same markets, using the distribution and customer relationships our portfolio already owns.

You'll ship AI into production against real workflows, real customers, and a P&L you can see move within a quarter.

We hire people who want scope, speed, and ownership, and who are tired of working on AI that never reaches a customer. If you want to spend the next five years shipping into software that already runs the economy, talk to us. 

Job Description
This is a remote position.

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance—helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc’s next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests.

You’ll also own how we test AI itself. You’ll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc’s AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You’ll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release.
- Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records.
- Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge.
- Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production.
- Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows.
- Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis.
- Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value.
- Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
- Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time.
- Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts.

AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING
AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will:
- AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement.
- Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright’s MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code.
- Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner.
- Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators.
- Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes.
- AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what “good enough for the ED” means in measurable terms.
- Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams.

THE STACK YOU’LL SHAPE
This is our starting point, not a mandate. You’ll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them.
- UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core).
- API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces.
- Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing.
- Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features.
- AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith.
- CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
- First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc’s clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You’ve proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records.
- By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results.
- By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today’s. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features.

Requirements
- Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
- QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles.
- Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code.
- Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.
- AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow.
- Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds.
- Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results.
- API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines.
- Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude.
- Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Nice to have
- Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments.
- AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams.
- Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG.

Benefits
- Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation.
- Global Team Collaboration—work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world.
- Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge.
- Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization.
- Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind.
- Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
**Role & responsibilities**

We are hiring an Automation Test Engineer with 4+ years of experience to own functional, integration

and regression testing of our private cloud platform, built on OpenStack and Ceph. You will design

automated test suites, run them continuously against our environments, and help the team ship

platform changes with confidence.

  

**Key responsibilities**



Analyse cloud platform features and changes, then write test plans, test scenarios and test cases

covering functional, integration, regression and negative paths.



Design, build and maintain automated test suites for platform services such as compute (Nova),

networking (Neutron/OVN), block and object storage (Cinder, Ceph RBD/RGW), identity

(Keystone) and images (Glance).



Automate end-to-end workflows: tenant and project onboarding, VM lifecycle, volume

attach/detach, snapshots, floating IPs, security groups, load balancers and quota enforcement.



Test platform APIs (OpenStack REST APIs, CLI and SDK) and validate responses, error handling

and multi-tenant isolation.



Execute automated and manual test runs, triage failures, and log clear, reproducible defects with

logs and steps.



Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines so they run on every build, upgrade and configuration

change.



Run upgrade, failover and resilience tests, such as controller node loss, Ceph OSD failure and

network path failover, and verify the platform recovers as expected.



Support performance and scale testing with tools like Rally, and report on latency, throughput

and capacity limits.



Maintain test environments and test data, and keep the automation framework clean, reusable

and documented.



Publish test reports and quality metrics (pass rate, coverage, defect trends) to engineering and

operations teams.•

Work closely with platform, network and storage engineers during sprint planning, release

readiness and production change validation.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

**Required skills and qualifications**



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent experience.



4+ years of software testing experience, including at least 2 years building test automation from

scratch.



Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Java/Go for writing test code.



Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Pytest and playwright.



Solid API testing experience using REST clients, Postman or code-based API test suites.



Working knowledge of cloud or virtualisation platforms: OpenStack, VMware, AWS, Azure or

KVM.



Good Linux skills: shell scripting, log analysis, systemd services and basic troubleshooting.



Understanding of networking basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, DNS, DHCP and firewalls.



Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or Zuul.



Familiarity with containers (Docker) and basic Kubernetes concepts.



Strong grasp of testing fundamentals: test design techniques, STLC, defect lifecycle and test

reporting.



Experience with a defect and test management tool such as Jira, TestRail or Xray.



Clear written and verbal communication for defect reports and test summaries.

**Preferred skills (nice to have)**



Direct experience testing OpenStack services, or using OpenStack test tools such as Tempest and

Rally.



Exposure to Ceph storage (RBD, RGW, CephFS) and its failure and recovery behaviour.



Knowledge of software-defined networking: OVS, OVN, VXLAN/Geneve overlays, BGP.



Infrastructure-as-code and configuration tools: Ansible, Terraform or Kolla-Ansible.



Performance and load testing with Rally, Locust, JMeter or fio.



Monitoring and logging stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana or ELK/OpenSearch for test

validation.



Security and multi-tenancy testing (RBAC, network isolation, policy enforcement).



ISTQB or equivalent testing certification; OpenStack (COA) or cloud certifications.

description:

**About Accelirate**

Accelirate is a leading agentic AI and automation firm, building intelligent agents that transform enterprise operations. Were a certified partner of UiPath, Microsoft, and Salesforce, with 1500+ processes automated annually across industries. Honored as a Top Workplaces USA winner five years in a row, we’re known for delivering scalable, agent-driven solutions that empower humans, agents, and robots to work smarter together.

  

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Test Automation Engineer to own Playwright + Python UI automation for our web applications. You will build maintainable pytest-based frameworks, run them in CI on Azure Pipelines, keep the suite fast and reliable, and mentor junior engineers.

What you will do

* Design and extend a Playwright + Python framework on pytest, using Page Object Model, fixtures and reusable utilities.
* Automate end-to-end UI tests from user stories and acceptance criteria, across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
* Build stable locator strategies and keep the flaky-test rate under 2%.
* Integrate suites into Azure Pipelines with parallel runs (pytest-xdist) and useful failure artifacts (traces, screenshots, videos).
* Track tests and defects in Azure Boards and Test Plans, linked to user stories for traceability.
* Triage failures daily and report coverage, pass rate, execution time and flakiness each sprint.
* Review peers' automation code and mentor 13 junior engineers.

What you bring

* **Playwright (Python):** built or substantially extended a framework; strong with the sync/async APIs, auto-waiting, locators, browser contexts, network interception/mocking, auth via storage state, and Trace Viewer.
* **Python:** OOP, type hints, decorators, context managers, exception handling, virtual environments; clean, modular code checked with Ruff or Flake8 and Black.
* **pytest:** fixtures and scopes, conftest.py, markers, parametrization, pytest-playwright plugin, pytest-xdist, HTML/JUnit reporting.
* **Azure DevOps and Git:** Git in Azure Repos (branching, pull requests, code reviews, conflict resolution); YAML Pipelines, Boards and Test Plans; publishes test results to pipelines.
* **Testing fundamentals:** test pyramid, test design techniques, risk-based prioritisation, basic SQL, Agile/Scrum.
* Clear communication and ownership; can explain a failure to a developer and a risk to a product owner.

Good to have

* API testing with Python (requests, httpx or Playwright's APIRequestContext).
* GitHub and GitHub Actions workflows.
* Migration from Selenium to Playwright.
* BDD with pytest-bdd or Behave.
* Docker, Azure cloud basics, Allure reporting.
* Visual regression and accessibility testing (axe-core).
* AI-assisted testing: GitHub Copilot, Playwright MCP.
* ISTQB certification.

Education

B.E./B.Tech/MCA in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Domain Test and Automation Engineer / Microcontroller & Real Time OS**
========================================================================

**Unit and team Overview**
--------------------------

Infotainment platforms unit is responsible for developing, maintaining and deploying BMW infotainment platform. The unit is also responsible for cross-cutting concerns of the platform, like architecture, security, stability and performance. The platform is deployed into multiple infotainment domain ECUs, ranging from headunits and rear seat entertainment systems to telematics and audio ECUs.

**Base system Center of Competence (CoC)**
------------------------------------------

### **Team responsibilities under CoC**

The team's area of responsibility is to handle requirements for the Microcontroller, develop the components of a platform for MCU that can be used by multiple vendors who would then fulfill the requirements on their specific BSP.

**Job Description**
-------------------

* Design, develop and maintain automated test cases using Robot Framework for our domain's functionality which are near to Hardware.
* Integrate domain test suites into the central CI/CD pipeline and ensure stable, reliable test execution.
* Set up and maintain hardware test benches, including wiring and connecting ECUs, power supplies, relays and measurement equipment.
* Develop test automation to control power supply units and relays (e.g., for power-cycle, voltage and fault injection tests).
* Use oscilloscopes and other lab equipment to analyze signals and troubleshoot hardware-related issues.
* Analyze test results, logs and traces to identify and report defects, working closely with developers to resolve them.
* Continuously increase automated test coverage, prioritizing based on domain risk and feature roadmap.
* Execute test cases hands-on, both automated and manual, to gain first-hand understanding of product behavior and improve test coverage.
* Willing to execute manual tests when needed, for example for new features or scenarios not yet automated, in addition to the primary focus on test automation.
* Collaborate with the central test automation framework team to align on best practices, reusable keywords and framework enhancements.

* Business fluent English
* University degree in electrical/electronics engineering, computer science or a comparable field of study

* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing test cases with Robot Framework
* Experience working with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers

### **Required Experience and Skills**

* Hands-on experience writing and maintaining test automation using Robot Framework (keyword-driven testing, custom libraries).
* Solid Python development skills, ideally for building custom Robot Framework libraries and test tooling.
* More than basic hardware knowledge, including hands-on experience connecting and wiring ECUs, power supplies, relays and other lab/bench equipment.
* Experience using oscilloscopes and similar measurement tools to analyze electrical signals and diagnose hardware issues.
* Experience with Linux systems and embedded/automotive software testing.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Zuul CI, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
* Ability to analyze logs/traces and systematically root-cause test failures.
* Good communication skills and willingness to work closely with developers and manual testers.

------------

* Test Automation

* Linux / Yocto
